title: Gran Turismo 7
shortDescription: Kazunori Yamauchi's 25th anniversary magnum opus, combining obsessive photographic car physics simulation with an interactive living museum of automotive history.
historicalSignificance: The definitive modern sim racing flagship, celebrated for simulating micro-meteorological surface water evaporation on tarmac, full ray-traced replays, and full-game virtual reality integration on PlayStation VR2.

editorialContent.overview: Marking 25 years since the franchise debuted on PS1 in 1997, Gran Turismo 7 returns to the classic single-player World Map campaign centered around the 'GT Café', where players complete curated Menu Books detailing the engineering heritage of over 500 legendary vehicles.
editorialContent.gameplay: Pinnacle vehicle physics simulation tracking tire temperature, aerodynamic downforce, suspension geometry, and real-time changing weather and track wetness drying lines.
editorialContent.technicalInnovation: Features full ray tracing in garage and replay modes, 3D spatial acoustic audio locating exhaust revs, and revolutionary tactile feedback through DualSense adaptive triggers reproducing anti-lock brake shudder.
editorialContent.culturalImpact: Serves as an authoritative interactive global cultural archive for automotive preservation, collaborating directly with Michelin, Brembo, and world-renowned car designers.
editorialContent.preservationNotes: Preserved on PS5 Ultra HD disc, completely playable in full stereoscopic 3D VR on PlayStation VR2.

awards: The Game Awards Best Sports/Racing Game 2022
D.I.C.E. Racing Game of the Year
